ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #4
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27
   C. 27.6
   D. 27.7

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 44
   C. 30
   D. 15

3. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 2/2
   C. Cannot tell
   D. They are equal

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 10
   C. 14
   D. 2

5. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 23.6
   C. 29
   D. 23

6. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 43
   D. 1

7. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 25
   D. 1

8. Solve for x: x + 5 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 12
   C. 11
   D. 16

9. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

10. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 32
   C. 64
   D. 8

11. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 156
   C. 24
   D. 144

12. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 15
   C. 57
   D. 56

13. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

14. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2, 4, 6
   B. 3, 6, 9
   C. 1, 6
   D. 1, 2, 3, 6

15. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 38
   B. 30
   C. 60
   D. 19

16. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 49
   C. 50
   D. 7

17. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 26
   C. 170
   D. 13

18. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 32
   C. 4
   D. 12

19. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 81
   C. 36
   D. 18

20. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 12x

21. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 25
   C. 24
   D. 2

22. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.7
   C. 19.6
   D. 25

23. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 42
   C. 36
   D. 12

24. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 15.7
   C. 15.6
   D. 21

25. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 10
   C. 25
   D. 26

26. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

27. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 40
   C. 13
   D. 41

28. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 49

29. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.6
   C. 31
   D. 31.7

30. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 122
   C. 11
   D. 121

----
